text:
Iris (Design): Dropped a small concept for a "Notify chain" view in the alert preview. Instead of a flat list it shows the routing path (primary -> fallback -> global). Sketch + figma link: https://figma.redwood/notify-chain

Ben (PM): Neat. Use case: on-call wants to quickly see why pager didn't fire and whether email or SMS was chosen as fallback. Can we show precedence rules inline?

Kai (Frontend): Technical note: a compact flow with nodes and arrows is fine but SVG graphs are tough for SR. Proposal: visual graph + an accessible linearized list for screen readers. Example list: `1. PagerDuty (rate-limited) -> 2. Email (delivered)`.

Sofia (A11y): Strong agree on linearization. For the graph itself: each node should be `role="button" aria-expanded` when it has details, and the whole graph should have `aria-label="Notification chain for rule X"`. Provide a textual summary above: "Chain complete: PagerDuty skipped; Email used." Use `aria-live` when the chain recomputes.

Derrick (SRE): Also include the policy that caused the skip (e.g., rate limit, suppression, escalation) and the timestamp of last match. If fallback was auto-escalated after N failures, surface that N. Helpful for postmortems.

Iris (Design): UI idea: compact nodes with short state chips (notified / skipped / fallback) and a small reason tooltip. Below the SVG show a collapsed "Linearized chain" that expands to a step-by-step annotated list. Copy nit: prefer "skipped" over "suppressed" in the flow because it's shorter and reads better inline.

Ben (PM): Copy vote: "skipped" ok for compact, but ensure full aria text uses explicit reason (e.g., "skipped due to quiet window"). Also add a CTA: "Run chain simulation" that re-evaluates with current draft rules.

Kai (Frontend): Implementation sketch: the sim API returns `chain: [{channel:"pager", state:"skipped", reason:"rate_limit", lastMatch:"2025-03-04T12:01:02Z"}, ...]`. We render SVG based on that and build the linearized list with the same data.

Sofia (A11y): When building the linear list, include `aria-posinset` and `aria-setsize` for each step. For the graph nodes, add `tabindex=0` and on Enter/Space open a details panel with full explanation. Avoid separate focus traps inside the SVG.

Derrick (SRE): Edge case: chained fallbacks across regions (us-east -> eu-west) with differing quiet hours. We should show timezone context per node and a small flag icon for region. Also show whether the chain used cached route info or live routing.

Iris (Design): I'll add a tiny region tag under nodes and a timestamp pill for last-eval. Banner copy when sim runs: "Simulation complete    3 steps: Pager (skipped) -> Email (sent) -> SMS (not attempted)". Will make it more natural language before finalizing.

Ben (PM): Also request an export button: CSV of chain steps for runbooks. Format: `step,channel,state,reason,lastMatch,region`. Useful for incident writeups.

Kai (Frontend): We'll add `?export=csv` on sim endpoints. Example: `/api/simulate_chain?policy=p-1&export=csv`. Backend will stream small CSV.

Sofia (A11y): For CSV downloads, ensure filenames are descriptive and sanitized: `notify-chain-p-1-20250304.csv` and do not leak user emails in the filename.

graph-bot: simulation run complete for p-1 at 2025-03-04T12:05:10Z  result: pager skipped (rate_limit), email delivered, sms not_attempted.

Iris (Design): Thanks  will update mock to include linearized list, CSV export, region badges, and aria copy per Sofia. If no other blockers I'll hand off to @Kai for a spike. :thumbsup:
